results.raw: False. The claim is impossible: PL 1828/2026 cannot have been published on 2026-04-14 because that date is in the future.
False. Lei nº 15.380 cannot have been published on 06/04/2026; that date is in the future and no such law exists.
False. The date 2026-03-21 is in the future, so this edition cannot have been published.
False. The decision date (2026-03-25) is in the future, so the claim cannot be true.
False. Resolution 784 was published on 8 November 2024, not 7 November 2025; the future date is impossible.
True. The claim accurately identifies RN 216/2010 as an official normative resolution issued by Brazil’s Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar on 14 April 2010.
False. PL 1828/2026 is a Brazilian bill, not a Colombian Senate law; the cited source is implausible.
False. The date 06/04/2026 is in the future, so no such law can have been published.
False. The Diário Oficial de Mogi Guaçu is a Brazilian municipal gazette; it cannot be published via Uruguay’s IMPO Open Data JSON API.
True. The TST (Tribunal Superior do Trabalho) is Brazil’s highest labor court and routinely publishes “Acórdão – AIRR” decisions, including the cited 2024-03-25 ruling.
False. Anatel Resolution 784 is a Brazilian telecommunications regulation, not an Argentine BCRA communication.
False. RN 216/2010 is a Brazilian ANS resolution; Chile’s BCN Linked Open Data cannot be its official publication source.
